description:
The Sales Director has decided to split the sales organization by territory. A new dedicated team is needed for the West Coast region.

Your tasks are:

1. Go to Configuration > Sales Teams and create a new team named exactly "West Coast".
2. Find all active opportunities in the pipeline that belong to customers in **California**.
3. Reassign these specific opportunities to the new "West Coast" sales team.

Make sure NOT to move opportunities from other states (like New York or Texas).
